projects.zh: A launcher for PC games on a jailbroken PS5, built on prospero-win (Wine, DXVK, VKD3D-Proton). Install games from USB with automatic covers, pick them from a carousel, and use the DualSense: vibration, light bar, adaptive triggers. FPS counter and update check. Games that need a launcher to start are not supported.
projects.en: A launcher for PC games on a jailbroken PS5, built on prospero-win (Wine, DXVK, VKD3D-Proton). Install games from USB with automatic covers, pick them from a carousel, and use the DualSense: vibration, light bar, adaptive triggers. FPS counter and update check. Games that need a launcher to start are not supported.
